t.zh: 流水线常常只要图里的一部分，比如物体所在的那一片。手上的<part-ref to="resizeNearest"></part-ref>改的是整张图的尺寸，每个输出像素都在整张图上采样。这一关的问题是：从一张图里取出一部分时，输出的像素值是原图里已有的，还是新算出来的？
t.en: A pipeline often wants only part of an image, the region where an object is, say. The <part-ref to="resizeNearest"></part-ref> in hand changes the whole image's size, every output pixel sampled across the whole image. This level asks: when part of an image is taken out, are the output's pixel values ones the original holds, or newly computed?

t.zh: 输入一张图、窗口左上角的 x0、y0 和窗口的宽 w、高 h。交出窗口里的像素，测试逐格和原图核对；隐藏测试里有贴边的窗口和彩色图。
t.en: The inputs are an image, the window's top-left x0, y0, and its width w and height h. Give the pixels inside the window; the tests check them cell by cell against the original, and hidden tests include windows on the border and a colour image.

desc.zh: 输入一张图、窗口左上角 x0、y0 和宽 w、高 h，输出窗口里的像素，值原样不变
desc.en: Takes an image, a window's top-left x0, y0 and its width w and height h; gives the pixels inside the window, values unchanged

after.zh: 这是<wiki-ref to="cropping"></wiki-ref>：取原数组的子区域，像素值原样保留。<wiki-ref to="numpy"></wiki-ref>写成 image[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w]。
after.en: This is <wiki-ref to="cropping"></wiki-ref>: a sub-region of the original array, its pixel values kept as they are. In <wiki-ref to="numpy"></wiki-ref> it is image[y0:y0+h, x0:x0+w].

brief.zh: 输入一张图、窗口左上角 (x0, y0) 和宽 w、高 h：交出窗口里的像素。
brief.en: Given an image, a window's top-left corner (x0, y0) and its width w and height h, give the pixels inside the window.

hint.zh: 窗口里坐标 (x, y) 的像素，是原图里的哪一个？
hint.en: Which pixel of the original is the window's pixel at (x, y)?
